description: How long Spanish consulates in the US and the UK took to decide residence visa applications (mostly non-lucrative visas) in My Spain Visa's own cases decided from January 2025 to October 2026: median days and 75th percentile per consulate, plus the wait each consulate publishes. Give a consulate, or the user's US state / UK region to find theirs. Without arguments it returns the overview.

state_or_region.description: US state (and county if California) or UK county/region.

name: consulate_processing_times
title: Spanish consulate processing times
